messages.subject: Windows 2K & Distance 3.5
parts:
Has anyone tried running Distance 3.5 under Windows 2000? If so, please could
you email me (not the list!) with your experiences. I've had a user write to
say that they couldn't get it to work, but I was not aware of any problems
under Windows 2000, so I'd like to know if there are some issues. Thanks,

- Len Thomas


--
Len Thomas, Co-ordinator
Distance Development Project
Research Unit for Wildlife Population Assessment
Mathematical Institute, University of St Andrews
Scotland KY16 9SS

email: dist...@mcs.st-and.ac.uk
RUWPA home page: http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk
